22.content:
The 2015 Pulse Gala was CRF’s signature fundraising event supporting cardiovascular research and education. The event honored Dr. Henry Kissinger and also recognized Dr. Roman W. DeSanctis.

Developed the standalone responsive event microsite using HTML5, Bootstrap, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery. The site included smooth-scroll navigation, expandable gala and support content, image-based campaign navigation and a responsive event gallery.

Integrated Wufoo forms for event participation and fundraising workflows and supported the event with responsive email communications through Salesforce Pardot.

23.content:
Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT) is CRF’s annual scientific conference focused on interventional cardiology. The 2015 meeting combined a large educational program with conference information, event resources and supporting digital communications.

Developed the TCT 2015 conference front end within CRF’s Joomla/PHP environment. The homepage combined an HTML5 video background with a custom triangular navigation interface drawn with Raphael.js and linked to major conference destinations.

Implemented responsive Week-at-a-Glance interactions with jQuery and Bootstrap, including day filters, expandable desktop session rows and separate mobile accordion behavior. Supporting conference email communications were developed and distributed through Salesforce Pardot.

Developed the responsive TCT Industry front end within the CRF Joomla/PHP environment using Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery, SCSS, HTML5 and CSS.

Implemented the conference information and responsive interface behavior for the industry-focused site and supported the event with related email communications.
